problem.title: Show that the Werner state rho(4, -1/2) of two ququarts is not 2-copy distillable

question.summary: The source asked for a proof that the two-ququart Werner state rho(4,-1/2) is not 2-copy distillable. Fu, Gao and Park, together with three concurrent teams, proved that a Werner state is 2-copy distillable only if it is already 1-copy distillable, which covers this state.
question.importance: The state sits exactly on the boundary between 1-copy distillable and 1-copy non-distillable Werner states, and its partial transpose is uniquely proportional to a dichotomic unitary, a property preserved under tensor products, which makes it the most tractable concrete step toward proving the existence of NPT bound entanglement.

targetClauses.label: Two-copy non-distillability of rho(4,-1/2)
targetClauses.text: The archived statement asks to show that the two-ququart Werner state rho(4,-1/2) is not 2-copy distillable, equivalently that no rank-two projector pair makes the doubled partial transpose acquire a negative eigenvalue.
targetClauses.resolutionCriteria: A proof of two-copy non-distillability, equivalently of the Pankowski-Piani-Horodecki-Horodecki matrix inequality, or an explicit two-copy distillation protocol.

claims.title: Werner states are 2-copy distillable only if 1-copy distillable
claims.text: Fu, Gao and Park prove that a Werner state in any local dimension is 2-copy distillable if and only if it is already 1-copy distillable, which in the archived parametrisation gives 2-copy non-distillability exactly for alpha at least -1/2 and therefore includes rho(4,-1/2). Song and Chen, Fraser, Huber, Pozsgay and Vona, and Bharti, Gajjala and Haug posted concurrent independent proofs of the same sharp two-copy threshold, so the archived statement is affirmed.

evidence.sourceLocator: Main theorem on the sharp two-copy threshold
evidence.label: arXiv:2607.21367

decisions.rationale: Four concurrent exact manuscripts prove the sharp two-copy threshold for Werner states, which includes rho(4,-1/2) and therefore settles the archived statement. The resolution rests on four concurrent July 2026 preprints (Fu-Gao-Park, Song-Chen, Fraser-Huber-Pozsgay-Vona, Bharti-Gajjala-Haug); none had passed peer review on the 2026-08-12 verification date, so this is a corroborated preprint resolution rather than a mature consensus result.

cautions.label: Scope
cautions.text: These papers settle two-copy distillability for Werner states; they do not prove non-distillability for every number of copies and do not resolve whether NPT bound-entangled states exist.
